scope.title: EvidencePack: Structured extraction from 'Secular Outlook — Economic and investment trends shaping the current decade' (Julius Baer)
scope.purpose: Create a structured EvidencePack that extracts, summarizes, and packages the publication's key findings, charts, data, metadata and risk points to support investment research, review, and compliance use-cases.
objectives: Extract publication metadata (title, authors, publication date, imprint/disclaimer).
Summarize the executive/editorial overview and each major section (Historical secular trends; Key macroeconomic trends; Key capital market trends; Key risk factors).
Identify and extract each chart/figure and capture underlying numeric data where present (tables or digitizable chart data).
Capture key risk factors and highlighted assumptions.
Produce machine-readable outputs: JSON summaries, CSVs for extracted tables/data, and PNGs for charts/images.
Record source citations for every extracted item.
in_scope: All main content sections listed in the document's table of contents (editorial; historical secular trends; key macroeconomic trends; key capital market trends; key risk factors; imprint) as present in the uploaded file .
All charts and figures appearing in the publication (capture images and attempt to extract numeric data).
Publication metadata (title page and publication date) and listed authors/contacts on the imprint page .
Textual summaries (paraphrases and short extracts) necessary to convey findings and support analysis.
References and footnotes included in the file.
out_of_scope: Full verbatim reproduction of the publication beyond short fair-use excerpts (no wholesale copying of copyrighted text).
Any third-party materials not embedded in the uploaded file.
Providing legal, tax, or individualized investment advice based on the extracted material.

timeframe.data_coverage: Content and data included in the uploaded publication (up to Q4 2025 as documented in the file) .

data_sources: Document table of contents previewed in the uploaded file
deliverables: EvidencePack JSON containing: metadata, section summaries, extracted chart metadata and data pointers, extracted risk matrix, and a references list.
CSV files for any tabular/chart numeric data extracted.
PNG files for each chart/figure extracted from the PDF.
A short extraction log documenting any pages or elements that could not be machine-extracted and require manual review.
constraints: Respect copyright and only include summaries or short quoted excerpts as permitted; link to source citation for each item.
Extraction quality may vary for complex charts/low-resolution images; manual validation may be required.
Do not fabricate numeric values — where chart data cannot be reliably digitized, flag for manual transcription.
acceptance_criteria: EvidencePack JSON populated with publication metadata and a summary for each in-scope section.
All charts present in the PDF captured as image files and annotated with page/figure identifiers.
Numeric data available for at least the top 10 charts (where digitizable); otherwise flagged for manual extraction.
References field lists the original uploaded file with citation markers used in the pack.
assumptions: The uploaded PDF is the authoritative source for this EvidencePack and contains the sections referenced in the TOC .
No additional documents are required beyond the uploaded file unless requested.
